purpose: Predict behavior based on a person’s familiar character.
keywords: Knowing how careful she is, she has probably checked already.
Knowing my father, who loves cooking, he will gladly cook for us.
Knowing responsible Mori, they would not miss work without contacting us.
restrictions: Usually relies on a character trait shared with the listener.
mistake: It is not a general substitute for every use of だから.
